scope: Synthetic D4 resource-search observations and design expectations, not an API schema or measured runtime behavior. Document/KV summaries require future owning contracts.

search.matching: Authorized resource-name prefix, exact first, then kind (Table, Document, KV), then stable name/identity order.
search.sql_before_and_after_search: SELECT id, value FROM samples WHERE id >= 104 LIMIT 3;

cardinality.coverage: Entire samples Table in d2-fixture.json, excluding framework entries.
cardinality.producer: Synthetic observation derived from D2's six rows; a real owner-produced summary is not implemented.

size.derivation: 6 rows * 2 non-null INT64 values * 8 bytes; excludes keys, null maps, encoding headers, indexes, retained history and storage overhead.
size.label: 96 B · value payloads

cardinality.reason: One Document is not a row collection; do not invent a Table cardinality.

size.producer: Synthetic future Document metadata observation, not derived from payload reads or claimed as an existing encoding.
size.label: 12 KiB · encoded state

schema_preview.origin: Synthetic registered Document shape, future contract

cardinality.coverage: Named user keyspace, excludes framework records.

interaction_expectations.action: Type sam in resource search while Live
interaction_expectations.expected: Only metadata discovery; SQL draft and generation unchanged, no new data-query submission.
No SQL edit; already admitted worksheet work can continue.

interaction_expectations.action: Insert selected queryable name at an unchanged captured FROM position
interaction_expectations.expected: One quoted, undoable SQL edit; resulting draft is eligible for Live scheduling.

interaction_expectations.action: Insert after the captured SQL document/range changes
interaction_expectations.expected: No replacement; require a current SQL insertion position.

interaction_expectations.action: Select an inspection-only Document or KV
interaction_expectations.expected: Details available; SQL insertion unavailable in this profile.

interaction_expectations.action: Metric response arrives after resource revocation or scope change
interaction_expectations.expected: Discard it; no resurrection of names, counts, sizes or schemas.

interaction_expectations.action: Metrics arrive after the name page
interaction_expectations.expected: Replace pending metrics without reordering matches or moving selection.

interaction_expectations.action: Metadata observation is older than source but authorization remains current
interaction_expectations.expected: Show stale with original basis; never label the metric current.
Do not relabel it as logical Table rows or user keys.

interaction_expectations.action: Size unavailable or cardinality exactly zero
interaction_expectations.expected: Unavailable stays unavailable; an exact empty collection shows zero with its unit and basis.

interaction_expectations.action: Registered shape absent or beyond the preview budget
interaction_expectations.expected: Show Shape unavailable or +N fields; do not infer types or fetch payloads.

interaction_expectations.action: More matches exist beyond the bounded page
interaction_expectations.expected: Show continuation, never claim a whole-catalog count or fetch the entire catalog.
